mode_effect.description: Generation mode is the dominant driver of ordering divergence

evidence.within_arch_tau: Qwen-rewrite vs Qwen-cont τ=0.7333 (high but not 1.0 → mode does change ordering)

residual_architecture_effect.description: Architecture still contributes — Qwen-cont vs OLMo (0.54) remains below Pythia vs OLMo (0.73)
residual_architecture_effect.gap: Qwen-cont doesn't fully converge to Pythia-OLMo level, especially for OLMo pair

analysis.conclusion: Generation mode is the primary driver (~60-70% of divergence), architecture is secondary (~30-40%). C2 claim can state ordering is largely universal with mode as the main confound, but needs caveat about residual architecture differences.
